rationale.quality-debt: Interviews identify inaccurate, inefficient, error-prone, and maintenance-burdening generated code.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Authors recommend exhaustive, high-coverage tests to validate generated code.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Developers manually verify, debug, and extensively modify ChatGPT outputs.
rationale.survey-input: Interviews report usage frequency, trust judgments, concerns, and desired improvements.
rationale.assistive: Developers prompt ChatGPT and inspect generated code within their workflow.
rationale.steering: Several proposed improvements reshape training, feedback, context, and model inputs.
rationale.risk-quality: Study reports functional inaccuracies, inefficiency, complexity limitations, and maintenance concerns.
rationale.method-self-report: Twenty developers and researchers provided evidence through qualitative interviews.
